affected_locations: Dakshin Bedkashi Union, Koyra Upazila, Khulna District, Bangladesh
key_impacts: 3,520 houses washed away in Dakshin Bedkashi
1,800 houses partially damaged in Dakshin Bedkashi
Coastal embankment breached in six places; 20.55 km damaged (of 27.37 km)
Prolonged twice-daily tidal inundation until 2013 due to embankment breaches
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with 65-knot winds and 2–6 m storm surge.
In Dakshin Bedkashi, Aila killed 33 people, washed away 3,520 houses, partly damaged 1,800, inundating almost the entire union.
Storm surge overtopped and breached the coastal embankment in six places, damaging 20.55 km (of 27.37 km).
